findings.evidence: distance/dmin/exempt[2,2] with q/qd/pending batch1 and J[1,2,D] returned finite distance[2,2],risk_margin[2], instead of aborting malformed per-environment binding.
findings.impact: Torch broadcast can silently reuse one environment state/J for another. No such corruption observed in actual simulator; this is a missing validation boundary.
findings.minimum_fix: Require exact N/M/arm dimensions for allq/qd/J/pending and matching float tensor contracts before arithmetic.

findings.scope: reference_bounds pure helper; full guard has additional upstream limits checks
findings.impact: Standalone function violates finite interval/abort contract. Existing full_forecast validates limits before project, so this probe does not prove a live guard bypass.
findings.minimum_fix: Validate finite limits/box and exact compatible shapes before interval construction; finite ordered output.

findings.evidence: reference_envelope_unreachable is computed using fixed.050 for every mode. q=0,target=.030,box=.016: .050 reachable, .010 disjoint singleton-.016.
findings.impact: Saved field cannot truthfully represent actual tight/adaptive envelope unreachability; control gap itself is dynamically wired.
findings.minimum_fix: Keep fixed.050 metric explicitly baseline-labelled and add actual-gap diagnostic after reserve is computed, or rename/document the existing baseline-only field. No policy change required.
